text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Siiigh… It's kinda boring just going home. I wonder if there's something fun we could do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Actually, ever since I saw how much fun she had at the zoo, I've been looking into other places that she might enjoy. This might be the perfect opportunity to try!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You seem awfully sure of yourself. Is it really that fun?
choice_data_list: I have a careful selection of magical locations!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh yeah? If you're really that confident, let's see what you got!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: First, I take her to a place where a sword-and-sorcery fantasy movie was shot. However…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I thought you said we were going somewhere where there was a great magical battle?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Woosh…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Are you suuuure people used magic here? It's pretty weird there aren't any traces of magic at all!
choice_data_list: W-well, next is a place we can see magic!

text_block_list.name: Wandering Magician
text_block_list.text: Abracadabra! Goodbye, sesame!

text_block_list.name: Wandering Magician
text_block_list.text: And there you have it! The card the young lady chose has disappeared! Isn't that incredible?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: What the heck? You call that magic? You just made a card disappear is all!

text_block_list.name: Wandering Magician
text_block_list.text: Huh?! H-how is that not surprising?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Grandma can do way more amazing magic than that! You're nothing more than a novice!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Oh! Now this place has some atmosphere! ♪ Is this some kind of ritual?

text_block_list.name: Man Dressed as Monk
text_block_list.text: Rin, Pyo, To, Sha, Kai, Jin, Retsu, Zai, Zen… KYAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Man Dressed as Monk
text_block_list.text: Join us, you two. None who wish to partake in the esteemed Miracle ☆ Training Experience… shall… es…cape…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: H-hey… Is it just me, or are they inching toward us? Something's really weird here!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every single place was vastly different from what I had imagined. I thought it would be okay as long as there was some connection to magic, but I should have looked into everything more.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, Familiar. Was that it?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You look like you just saw a ghost. Aha… That must mean…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Come on, Familiar! This is toootally unacceptable! You haven't trained enough! Get it together!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Here, drink this!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: This is the perfect tea for someone like you who's still short on training! It's super gross!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: It'll make you sweat until you're about to pass out! Come on, hurry up and drink it!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sweep Tosho creeps closer and closer. Then, before I can react, she grabs hold of me and forces her mystery tea down my throat!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A chill races through my whole body! An unbearable bitterness takes hold of my mouth, and my strength fails…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hey, you're awake! Haha! ♪ You should've seen the look on your face!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So how do you feel? What was it like to pass out? Was it so gross you're still speechless?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: My body feels shockingly light. It's as if all the exhaustion I've accumulated over the day has been swept away. This tea must have come from…

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: That was a super special medicine that Grandma taught me to make! It looks like it might've been a bit too strong for you, though.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: But at least you can move again! We can dive back into work tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Wow! You're really complaining about the taste?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I know some medicine that's waaay more bitter than that! And way more effective too! Maybe I should make that one for you next time.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Well, there's plenty more where that came from, so you can rest easy! Now be a good familiar, and work yourself ragged for me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The smile on her face as she concerns herself with my health makes me want to make the next time as fun as possible.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Hmph! Of course! It's my job to look after my familiars, after all.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Still, I can acknowledge your gratitude for having such a kind master! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her kindness as she concerns herself with my health makes me want to make the next time as fun as possible.
